newsitem.title: DUBAI: Gulf Arab helicopters in Kuwait for exercises.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Arab helicopters in Kuwait for exercises.

text.p: Helicopters and forces from Gulf Arab states arrived in Kuwait on Thursday for military exercises, Bahrain's official Gulf News Agency reported, but the exercises did not appear to be related to the crisis with Iraq.
The agency said a number of helicopters from the air forces of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states arrived at a Kuwaiti air base for exercises that will be held between September 14-19.

The agency said the manoeuvers were part of a GCC program of joint exercises. The GCC is a military, political and economic alliance that groups Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman.
